english.legislation: Contrary to section 54(1) of the Metropolitan Police Act 1839.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cleaned/ made / repaired any part of a cart / carriage
in a thoroughfare / public place within the MPD
to the annoyance of the inhabitants / passengers

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In accordance with section 76(1) of the London Government Act 1963, the "metropolitan police district shall consist of Greater London, excluding the city of London, the Inner Temple and the Middle Temple".
(ii) Repair may be made in the case of an accident where on the spot repair is necessary.
